entries.rationale: Well-specified config loader with exact acceptance criteria and direct golden sample match for library module pattern; minimal blast radius.
Explicit fail-fast and rollback-surfacing behaviors; combines fail-fast + reverse-order rollback but each part is well-specified with clear "never auto-execute" constraint.
Existing skill files provide a direct template; spec covers all behaviors but SKILL.md authoring requires creative composition of lib functions into coherent instructions.
Pure mechanical string formatting with explicit spec requirements; golden sample for library module pattern applies directly.
Spec provides exact regex patterns verbatim; extends existing validation function with mechanical pattern matching.
Executor registry + redaction + injectable executors combines multiple patterns; no golden sample for orchestrator pattern; DeployRun structure needs inference from charter.
Fully specified execFile wrapper with clear exit code semantics; mechanical implementation with established Node.js patterns.
Clear behavioral spec with callback-injection pattern for user input; no interactive prompt golden sample but pattern is straightforward.
Nearly identical to shell executor with different exit code interpretation; fully mechanical implementation.
Spec defines precise polling semantics with defaults and minimums; polling loop requires timer injection for testability but is a known pattern.
Detailed spec with exit code semantics and SEC-7 sanitization guidance; two-phase dispatch+poll combines patterns but each part is well-defined.
Clear version resolution behavior with --version override; external dependency on lib/milestones.mjs adds mild uncertainty but fallback path is well-defined.
